Keep both >500 m internal jumps as explicit QA caveats: 1257.4 m and 572.7 m.

iteration3Qa.gapFinding: The two >500 m gaps are inside GPX track 5, not between GPX track/segment boundaries. Inter-track jumps are effectively 0 m.
iteration3Qa.finalDrawRecommendation: Can draw from official GPX only if renderer preserves the 5 GPX tracks and additionally splits track 5 at >500 m jumps. Do not render track 5 as one continuous polyline across the two gap jumps.

iteration4Qa.drawCaveat: Use official GPX, but preserve breaks: 5 tracks/segments and split track 5 at the two >500 m jumps.

finalQa.finalDrawInstruction: Draw from official Naturkartan GPX only. Preserve the 5 GPX tracks and split track 5 at the two >500 m internal gaps; do not draw track 5 as one continuous polyline.

iterationLog.focus: Final five-agent pass over Etapp 10 mapdata, import buckets, pending/suppression decisions, schema QA and importer readiness.
iterationLog.result: Etapp 10 complete after five iterations. Keep all 12 import rows, 4 pending records and 11 suppressions.
